항목.프롬프트: Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: pairs of animals, two elephants, two lions, two giraffes, two sheep and two doves, each animal clearly its own kind, walk up a wooden ramp into this same huge long box-shaped wooden ark, a kind old man with a long white beard, cream headcloth and brown robe (Noah) and his family welcoming them, cloudy sky.
